title: Mass quench in interacting finite-size quantum field system
summary: In this work, we theoretically investigate the non-equilibrium evolution of the correlation functions of a quantum scalar field following a mass quantum quench in a finite-size system. The self-consistent equation for the Keldysh (statistical) correlation function is solved numerically in the one-loop approximation. A specific spatio-temporal effect is observed: at a point in time approximately equal to half the system size, the effective mass experiences a strong disturbance.
